description: Score a route/drive as a prospectivity PROFILE — the 'Gold Run' engine. Give the ordered polyline vertices of a road/track (e.g. a Mapbox Directions geometry) and it resamples the line at `spacing_km`, scores every sample live, and returns the along-route profile: total length, max/median score, and the hotspot peaks (the 'get out and dig here' spots) each with its distance along the route, score, tier and nearest known site.

points.description: Ordered route vertices (>=2), start to end

spacing_km.description: Sample interval along the route, km (0.2-25)

name: score_route
title: Score prospectivity along a route
